DashboardProfile.title: DashboardProfile
DashboardProfile.description: User-customized telemetry dashboard layout synced across devices.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the dashboard owner.

name.description: Display name of the dashboard profile (1 to 50 chars).

isDefault.description: Whether this profile loads automatically on launch.

widgets.description: Ordered list of widget configurations (up to 24 widgets).

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

CustomPidConfig.title: CustomPidConfig
CustomPidConfig.description: User-defined OBD-II or multi-header CAN UDS Mode 21/22 PID formula.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the owner.

pidKey.description: Unique key identifying the custom PID.

canHeader.description: Optional CAN header for ATSH switching (e.g. 7E0, 751, 7A0).

unit.description: Display unit (e.g. bar, C, g, V).

formula.description: Arithmetic decoding expression using bytes A, B, C, D.

targetWheel.description: Optional TPMS wheel assignment (FL, FR, RL, RR, or empty).

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

TripLog.title: TripLog
TripLog.description: Recorded daily commute OBD-II telemetry session summary and downsampled timeline.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the trip owner.

endedAtMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when recording stopped (0 while active).

sampleCount.description: Number of logged CSV telemetry samples.

distanceKm.description: Estimated distance in kilometers integrated from vehicle speed.

estimatedFuelLiters.description: Estimated diesel consumed in liters during the trip.

avgLitersPer100Km.description: Average estimated consumption in L/100 km.

avgLitersPerHour.description: Average estimated fuel rate in L/h.

trafficSeconds.description: Seconds spent idling or in stop-and-go queue (< 10 km/h with engine running).

dpfRegenDetected.description: Whether DPF active regeneration temperature (>= 500 C) was detected.

dpfRegenSeconds.description: Seconds spent at active DPF regeneration temperatures (>= 500 C).

csvFileName.description: Local CSV filename generated for this commute.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the trip log.

demoMode.description: Whether the trip was recorded using the Demo simulator.

timelinePoints.description: Downsampled telemetry timeline points (up to 60 points).

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/custom_pids/{pidId}.description: User-owned custom OBD-II/UDS CAN PIDs and TPMS wheel bindings.

/users/{userId}/trip_logs/{tripId}.description: User-owned daily commute OBD-II telemetry trip logs.
